subtitle: Regenerable or machine-specific — never source code

code:
# dependencies
node_modules/
vendor/

# build output
dist/
*.pyc

# editor/OS noise
.vscode/
.DS_Store

# local config & secrets
.env
*.pem
caption: Regenerable (deps, build) or person-specific (editor, local secrets) — never shared source.

code:
*.log            # any file ending in .log
/build            # only top-level build/
logs/             # any logs/ dir, any depth
!important.log    # exception — re-include this one
caption: A leading / anchors to root. A leading ! negates — re-includes one exception.

code:
$ git rm --cached config/secrets.yml
$ echo "config/secrets.yml" >> .gitignore
$ git commit -m "Stop tracking secrets.yml"
caption: .gitignore only affects files Git isn't tracking yet — untrack first.
